system.flavor:
Shout a warning so one friend braces before the barrel rolls off the cart, the ladder slips, the drunk's fist lands, or the horse sidesteps into them. They take the hit, but they take it ready.

Not enough to stop the barrel, or to warn more than one person at a time.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 2 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1.

surges.html: Reduce forced movement from that Action by 1 unit.
The target may move 1 unit toward you after the Action; self may move freely.
